questions.question: Which semiconductor device acts as a fundamental electronic switch and amplifier, forming the basis of modern digital integrated circuits?
In a typical five-stage CPU pipeline (Fetch, Decode, Execute, Memory, Write-back), what is the primary operation performed during the 'Execute' stage?
options: Accessing data from the data cache or main memory.
Translating instruction opcode into control signals.

questions.question: In deep submicron digital IC design, designers must extensively analyze circuit behavior across various corners defined by Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) variations. What is the primary reason for this comprehensive analysis?
options: To ensure the physical layout perfectly matches the schematic.
To optimize the size of the final silicon die for cost reduction.
To predict and guarantee reliable circuit operation and timing closure under all anticipated manufacturing and environmental conditions.
To identify and fix logical bugs in the RTL code before synthesis.
To reduce the number of test vectors required for post-silicon validation.

questions.question: Which formal verification technique is used to mathematically prove or disprove whether a finite-state model of a system satisfies a given set of temporal logic properties, exploring all possible system states exhaustively?
In modern computer systems, what is the primary function of the Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB)?
options: To store frequently used instructions for faster execution by the CPU.
To buffer write operations to main memory to improve performance.
To accelerate the translation of virtual memory addresses to physical memory addresses.
To maintain coherence between multiple CPU caches.
To manage the allocation and deallocation of heap memory.
